theorems.name: Submission.any_radius_rv_tangentProj_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U U' : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (W : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U') (c : Amb n ℓ) (R : ℝ), 0 < R → W.carrier = (fun x => c + R • x) ⁻¹' V.carrier → (∀ x, W.mult x = V.mult (c + R • x)) → ∀ x, W.tangentProj x = V.tangentProj (c + R • x)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
